description:
In this episode of “I’d Like to Know”, The Mark of the Beast –Microchips & Biometric Systems, with Pastors Stephen Bohr, C.A. Murray, and David Salazar answer one of the most important end-time questions: What is the Mark of the Beast?

📘 Bible Question Answered every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv — real Bible questions answered directly from Scripture.

00:00 Intro
01:05 — What Is the Mark of the Beast According to the Bible?
Many today believe the mark of the beast involves microchips, biometric systems, or digital tracking. But what does the Bible actually teach?
10:00 Microchips & Biometric Systems
